page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It features 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a single thread per core, eliminating hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance includes two NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 944 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

This hardware configuration represents a specialized resource density optimized for parallel processing workloads. The inclusion of dedicated physical cores and dual GPUs makes it suitable for legacy deep learning training, GPU-accelerated scientific simulations, and parallel computing tasks. However, the lack of modern tensor core architectures in the P100 GPUs compared to newer generations represents a performance tradeoff for modern large language model workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing and graphics-intensive workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it features 8 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with no hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 60.0 GB of system memory, two NVIDIA P100 GPUs providing a total of 32 GB of VRAM, and a local 944 GB SSD. Network performance is anchored by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth. This instance delivers a balanced ratio of dedicated compute power, local solid-state storage, and dual-GPU acceleration. It is suited for workloads such as legacy deep learning, scientific computing, and GPU-accelerated data processing where dedicated physical cores and dedicated graphics memory are required.
